versions.name: Rice Woods Camp
versions.address: E 600 N and N 1100 E, Walkerton, IN 46574
versions.summary: A La Salle Council camp property near Koontz Lake in northern Indiana, with Rice Lodge and wooded campsites used for weekend and troop camping and council service days.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified against La Salle Council (#165) sources, which list Rice Woods among the council's current properties (the source's lasallecouncilbsa.org/ricewoodsfaq link is a dead 404); the council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp runs at Camp Tamarack in Michigan while Rice Woods serves as a local short-term camping property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence and council (La Salle) verified; classified conservatively as a short-term camping property; features unsurveyed.
